briefing.id: Kamis malam, 22 Januari 2015. Siang tadi ECB mengumumkan program pembelian aset (quantitative easing) sekitar €60 miliar per bulan, lebih besar dari perkiraan banyak analis. Di sisi lain, The Fed masih membicarakan kenaikan suku bunga tahun ini, jadi arah kebijakan kedua bank sentral berbeda. Konferensi pers ECB sudah berakhir beberapa jam lalu. Saldo $2.000.
briefing.en: Thursday evening, 22 January 2015. Earlier today the ECB announced an asset purchase programme (quantitative easing) of about €60 billion a month, bigger than many analysts expected. The Fed, meanwhile, is still talking about raising rates this year, so the two central banks are heading in different directions. The ECB press conference ended a few hours ago. Balance $2,000.

briefing.id: Kamis, 27 November 2014. Dalam pertemuan di Wina hari ini OPEC memutuskan tidak memangkas produksi, padahal harga minyak sudah turun tajam sejak pertengahan tahun. USD/CAD juga sudah naik sejak pertengahan tahun. CAD termasuk mata uang komoditas yang erat dengan harga minyak. Hari ini Thanksgiving di AS, pasar AS libur, jadi likuiditas lebih tipis dari biasanya. Saldo $1.000.
briefing.en: Thursday 27 November 2014. At its meeting in Vienna today OPEC decided not to cut output, even though oil prices have fallen sharply since mid-year. USD/CAD has also been rising since mid-year. CAD is a commodity currency closely tied to the oil price. It's Thanksgiving in the US and US markets are closed, so liquidity is thinner than usual. Balance $1,000.

briefing.id: Akhir Juli 2017. Euro menguat sejak awal tahun. Kemenangan Emmanuel Macron di pemilu presiden Prancis (Mei) meredakan kekhawatiran politik, dan sejak pidato Mario Draghi di Sintra (27 Juni) pasar menduga ECB akan mulai mengurangi stimulus. Di AS, inflasi masih di bawah target 2% The Fed; Rabu (26 Juli) pukul 18.00 UTC The Fed mengumumkan keputusan suku bunganya. Saldo $10.000.
briefing.en: Late July 2017. The euro has been rising since the start of the year. Emmanuel Macron's win in the French presidential election (May) eased political worries, and since Mario Draghi's Sintra speech (27 June) the market expects the ECB to start scaling back stimulus. In the US, inflation is still below the Fed's 2% target; on Wednesday (26 July) at 18:00 UTC the Fed announces its rate decision. Balance $10,000.

briefing.id: 20 Desember 2016. Sejak awal November imbal hasil obligasi AS naik tajam dan dolar menguat terhadap yen. Pekan lalu (14 Desember) The Fed menaikkan suku bunga 0,25%, dan proyeksi anggotanya mengisyaratkan beberapa kenaikan lagi pada 2017. Bank of Japan mempertahankan kebijakan sangat longgar. Saldo $3.000.
briefing.en: 20 December 2016. Since early November US bond yields have climbed sharply and the dollar has strengthened against the yen. Last week (14 December) the Fed raised rates by 0.25%, and its members' projections pointed to several more hikes in 2017. The Bank of Japan is keeping its very loose policy. Balance $3,000.

text.en: With 2 lots, 1 pip is worth $20, so a small move against you already pushes the account toward a stop out.

text.en: The lot should come from the risk per trade and the SL distance, not from the maximum margin.
